payload.body: The electrical domain model of the robot arm.

The canary PCBA (canary step C1): the connector J1, with R1 between its two pins
(nets CANARY_A, CANARY_B). J1 carries Port = EE-PORT-0001 in the schematic, and
CK-F1 compares its pins and nets with the pin map below.
Two wires, 2-pin socket housings at both ends.
A 2-pin header, 2.54 mm pitch: J1 of the canary board.
The 2-pin plug of the test lead, 2.54 mm pitch.
A bought test lead: a 2-pin Dupont plug on two wires to the bench meter.
